name: The system acts on time
principle: The system starts its standing work when it is due, by calendar period in the person's own zone, when a run is requested, or when something happened.
state_description: Each schedule runs once per period, a requested run runs, an event runs a reactive schedule, and a corrupt time never stops one.
hints_of_measurement: Schedules due against schedules that should be due, over the cadence, zone, request and event cases.
